senses.gloss: f. (פָּרַק) taking apart, breaking up; untying.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:18">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>בשעת פְּרִיקָתָן וכ׳</he> at the taking apart of the tabernacle and its furniture &c., v. <cite ref="Q00843"><he>פֵּירוּק</he></cite>.
Sabb. 73ᵇ אין דרך פ׳ בכך this is not a way of disjointing.—Esp. untying and relieving a broken-down animal, unloading, opp. טְעִינָה.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 32a:19">B. Mets. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ בחנם</he> for unloading you must ask no remuneration; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 31a:22">ib. 31ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
